newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Mosenergo sees S&P rating in May.
newsitem.headline: Russian Mosenergo sees S&P rating in May.

text.p: Russian regional utility Mosenergo hopes to receive a Standard & Poor's credit rating in May for a $150 million Eurobond, an official from the company's securities department said on Monday.
"The Eurobond question is settled," he said. "The rating book is already done and we hope to get the rating in May," he added, naming S&P as the rating agency.
Mosenergo chief executive Nestor Serebryanikov in December said that Mosenergo planned to issue a Eurobond in the first quarter of this year.
The company also plans to issue a level one American Depositary Receipt, which allows foreign trading of shares, this year.
"All the documents were sent to the (U.S.) Securities Exchange Commission two weeks ago," the securities department official said.
"We have already signed the (depositary) agreement with the Bank of New York, and I think they have signed it, too."
